summary: The implementation satisfies the saved retention-cleanup plan: old completed PR workspaces are selected after retention, recent completed PR workspaces and failed workspaces are preserved with reason codes, cleanup deletes only managed pressure directories while preserving durable logs/artifacts and database history, repeated cleanup is structured and idempotent after partial Compose failures, settings drive retention defaults, service status and CLI output expose candidates/preserved workspaces and reasons, PR monitor completion defers recent filesystem cleanup, and required validation passed including ruff, mypy, full unit tests, and 99.00% coverage.
